outcome: Frequency of total salpingectomy versus occlusion or partial salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery
Operative times between the two procedures
cohort: 2110 women who underwent cesarean delivery with a concurrent permanent contraception procedure from July 1, 2014 to June 30, 2019 at 2 hospitals within a single healthcare system
finding: This study highlights provider and institutional characteristics associated with total salpingectomy compared to occlusion or partial salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery, which may inform future programs aimed at increasing utilization of total salpingectomy at cesarean delivery.
